payload.core_mechanism_summary: Binary search on number of items k, for each k compute item costs with formula a_i + (i+1)*k, sort, sum k cheapest, check budget.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts items by a custom cost function a_i + (i+1)*k, which changes with k, fitting sorting_custom_key. Binary search is on k but the key algorithmic step is sorting for each candidate k.
